name: mcx-core
description: Motorcortex platform context and live parameter access — terminology, how a Motorcortex system is put together, and skills to explore and write the parameter tree of a connected controller through a bundled MCP server.

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Motorcortex Core: the 'uv' command is not installed, so the mcx-core MCP server cannot start. Install it (macOS/Linux: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh  |  Windows: winget install astral-sh.uv) and restart Claude Code."; exit 0; }; uv run --isolated --no-project --quiet --python ">=3.10" --with-requirements "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/requirements.txt" python -c "import fastmcp, motorcortex" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Motorcortex Core: could not prepare the Python environment for the mcx-core MCP server. Check network access to PyPI, then restart Claude Code."
